To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the recognition performance of finger vein recognition systems can be significantly improved by fusing multiple views around the longitudinal axis, and that the fusion of the palmar and dorsal views is the most effective combination.
the best performing single views for fusion are the dorsal and the palmar view, the best fusion strategy is the score level fusion, and that the best fusion method is the sum fusion method.
The performance of a finger vein recognition algorithm can be improved by using multiple views of the finger.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the investigation of multi perspective finger vein recognition, where we established a new multi perspective finger vein database, analysed the recognition accuracy of different single views and fusion methods, and finally proposed an optimal multi perspective finger vein feature extraction and fusion method.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the performance can be improved over the best single view one with only 2 views and 2 feature extractors.
the fusion of multiple views is beneficial for finger vein recognition, and that a combination of the dorsal and the palmar view is the most promising one.

a combination of the palmar and lateral views, with the feature extraction methods of the Local Binary Pattern (LBP) and the Local Phase Quantization (LPQ) is the best performing fusion strategy in terms of the Equal Error Rate (EER) and the Receiver Operating Characteristics (ROC) of the fusion score.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a multi perspective finger recognition system can be designed to achieve a better recognition performance than a single view system while using less number of views.

the finger vein recognition accuracy can be significantly improved by utilising more than the traditional palmar view, and that the fusion strategy and the number of views used are of great importance.
the performance of finger vein recognition can be improved by utilising multiple views around the finger, and the fusion of different views can be done effectively using score level fusion.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to improve the recognition performance by fusing different views around the finger, which are currently not used in commercial products.
the finger vein recognition performance can be improved significantly by using all available views around the finger, not only the palmar one.
the fusion of multiple views around the finger can be very beneficial for the recognition accuracy and that the choice of the feature extraction methods to fuse is crucial.
